name: io.github.arcadia-finance/mcp-server
title: Arcadia Finance
description: Concentrated liquidity on Uniswap/Aero (rebalance, compound, leverage) or single-sided lending.

tools.name: read_account_info
tools.description: Get full overview of an Arcadia account: health factor, collateral value, debt, deposited assets, liquidation price, and automation status. Health factor = 1 - (used_margin / liquidation_value): 1 = no debt (safest), >0 = healthy, 0 = liquidation threshold, <0 = past liquidation. Higher is safer. The `automation` object reports which asset managers are enabled (rebalancer, compounder, yield_claimer, cow_swapper, merkl_operator, gas_relayer), each as the position's dex_protocol when protocol-specific or true when account-level and active, plus `inferred_intents` (the automations those managers add up to), `merkl` claim state, and `deprecated_managers` for any superseded deployment still set on the account. Superseded managers should be cleared: write_account_automations disables them as part of a save. For the full decoded per-manager config use read_asset_manager_current. LP positions in assets[] include a dex_protocol field (slipstream, slipstream_v2, slipstream_v3, metadexcl_v1, staked_slipstream, staked_slipstream_v2, staked_slipstream_v3, staked_metadexcl_v1, uniV3, uniV4). metadexcl_v1 is Aero CL, live on Base, Optimism and Robinhood for spot and margin accounts. Slipstream V2 is Base-only. V3 is available on Base and Optimism. Unichain supports Slipstream V1, uniV3 and uniV4. To configure automations, prefer passing the position's id as position_id to write_account_automations, which resolves the protocol and tokens for you; the dex_protocol value is also accepted directly as its `protocol` param. Numeric fields without a _usd suffix are in the account's numeraire token raw units (divide by 10^decimals: 6 for USDC, 18 for WETH, 8 for cbBTC). Fields ending in _usd are in USD with 18 decimals (divide by 1e18). health_factor is unitless. Asset amounts are raw token units. To list all accounts for a wallet, use read_wallet_accounts.

tools.name: read_account_history
tools.description: Get an Arcadia account's historical net value over time. Returns a time series of snapshots, oldest first, each `{ timestamp, net_value }` — `timestamp` is unix seconds and `net_value` is USD (human-readable, not raw units). Useful for charting account performance over a period. An empty `history` means the account has no snapshots in the window, not that the read failed.

tools.name: read_account_pnl
tools.description: Get PnL (cost basis) and yield earned for an Arcadia account. Returns lifetime totals: cost basis vs current value (negative cost_basis = net profit withdrawn), net transfers per token, total yield earned in USD and per token. cost_basis, current_value, cost_diff are in USD (human-readable). Per-token fields (net_transfers, summed_yields_earned) are in raw token units.

tools.name: read_pool_list
tools.description: List all Arcadia lending pools: TVL, utilization, available liquidity. Key fields: interest_rate = current borrow cost, lending_apy = lender yield. All rates are decimal fractions (1.0 = 100%, 0.06 = 6%). For APY history on a specific pool, use read_pool_info.

tools.name: read_pool_info
tools.description: Get detailed info for a single lending pool including APY history over time. Useful for analyzing rate trends and comparing pools. Use read_pool_list to discover pool addresses.

days.description: Number of days of APY history

tools.name: read_asset_list
tools.description: List supported collateral assets on Arcadia. Returns compact list (address, symbol, decimals, type). Use search to filter by symbol substring. For USD prices, use read_asset_prices.

search.description: Filter assets by symbol (case-insensitive substring match)

tools.name: read_asset_prices
tools.description: Get USD prices for one or more asset addresses on one chain. Pass a single address or comma-separated addresses. Returns a price map keyed by address. Unknown or unpriced addresses return 0, not an error. Prices are scoped to chain_id (default 8453, Base), so pass the chain the addresses live on. Read-only. To find asset addresses, use read_asset_list.

asset_addresses.description: Single address or comma-separated addresses for price lookup

tools.name: read_strategy_list
tools.description: Get Arcadia LP strategies. Use featured_only=true for curated top strategies (recommended first call); their apy is measured over the last 24 hours at the featured range width, and is 0.0 when that measurement fails. Otherwise returns a paginated list where strategy_apy_7d is the 7-day average APY at each strategy's default range. Increase limit or use offset for pagination. All APY values are decimal fractions (1.0 = 100%, 0.05 = 5%). For APY per range width over the last 24 hours, use read_strategy_info.

offset.description: Skip first N strategies for pagination

tools.name: read_strategy_info
tools.description: Get full detail for a specific concentrated-liquidity LP strategy by ID: includes APY per range width over the last 24 hours, each range anchored on the current price (narrower range = higher APY but more rebalancing cost/risk), the 7-day average APY at the default range in the yield field, pool info, and configuration. For basic (constant-product) pools, use strategy_apy_7d from read_strategy_list. Use read_strategy_list to discover strategy IDs. All APY values are decimal fractions (1.0 = 100%, 0.05 = 5%).

tools.name: read_strategy_recommendation
tools.description: Get a rebalancing recommendation for an Arcadia account: suggests asset changes to optimize yield. current_apy and proposed_apy are measured over the last 24 hours where possible (the account's positions at their own ranges, the proposal at its ranges), not the 7-day average of read_strategy_list, so recommended strategies may differ from the list ranking. APY values are decimal fractions (0.05 = 5%). weekly_earning_difference is in USD.

tools.name: read_point_leaderboard
tools.description: Get the Arcadia points leaderboard (paginated). For a specific wallet's points balance, use read_wallet_points.

offset.description: Skip first N leaderboard entries for pagination

tools.name: read_guides
tools.description: Get Arcadia workflow guides and reference documentation. Call this before multi-step workflows (opening LP positions, enabling automation, closing positions) or when you need contract addresses, asset manager addresses, or strategy parameters. Topics: overview (addresses + tool catalog), automation (intent-based automation setup), strategies (step-by-step templates), selection (how to evaluate and parameterize strategies).

topic.description: overview = addresses + tool catalog, automation = intent-based automation setup, strategies = step-by-step LP templates, selection = pool evaluation + leverage sizing

tools.name: read_wallet_balances
tools.description: Get native ETH and ERC20 token balances for a wallet address. Reads directly from chain via RPC multicall. Use before write_account_add_liquidity or write_account_deposit to verify the wallet has sufficient tokens. Returns both raw balance (smallest unit/wei) and formatted (human-readable) per token.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address to check balances for

token_addresses.description: ERC20 token contract addresses to check

tools.name: read_wallet_allowances
tools.description: Check ERC20 token allowances for a spender address. Use before write_wallet_approve to avoid redundant approvals: skip approving if the current allowance is already sufficient.

owner_address.description: Token owner address (the wallet granting approval)

spender_address.description: Spender address to check allowance for (e.g. Arcadia account address)

token_addresses.description: ERC20 token contract addresses to check

tools.name: read_wallet_accounts
tools.description: List all Arcadia accounts owned by a wallet address. Returns a summary of each account (address, name). Call read_account_info with a specific account_address for full details like health factor, collateral, and debt.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address to list accounts for

tools.name: read_wallet_points
tools.description: Get the Arcadia points balance for one wallet address. Returns points and wallet_address. A wallet with no points returns points 0 and wallet_address 'unknown', not an error. Read-only, no authentication. For the ranked list of wallets, use read_point_leaderboard.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address to get points for

tools.name: read_asset_manager_intents
tools.description: List the automation intents Arcadia supports, with the parameters each one accepts. Pass account_address to also get per-account availability: which intents can be enabled right now and, for any that cannot, the compatibility rule blocking it. Pass position_id as well to scope availability to one LP position. Without account_address this returns the catalog only.

account_address.description: Arcadia account address. Include it to get live per-account availability.

position_id.description: LP position (NFT) id to scope availability to. Requires account_address.

tools.name: read_asset_manager_current
tools.description: Read which asset managers are currently enabled on an account, with their decoded on-chain configuration. Returns the active managers (address, protocol, initiator, decoded strategy metadata, slippage and value-loss caps, fee recipient), the intents they map to, and Merkl claim state including whether reward tokens still need registering. Managers from superseded deployments are listed separately under `deprecated`: pass their addresses to write_account_automations_delta to clear them, or run write_account_automations which disables them as part of the save. A deprecated cow_swapper no longer swaps: a delta apply moves the account to the current CowSwapper and keeps its auto-swap target (buy token, sell tokens); a save keeps it only when its intents restate that target from the deprecated entry's metadata. read_ok is false when chain state could not be read, in which case the result is unreliable rather than empty.

tools.name: read_account_aero_upgrade
tools.description: Which Arcadia accounts have something to upgrade to Aero (MetadexCL V1): Slipstream V1 to V3 positions (Aerodrome on Base, Velodrome on Optimism, staked or not) and old AERO. Pass wallet_address for every account of a wallet, or account_address for one. Per account: status (ready | choices_required | waiting | not_open | nothing_to_upgrade), positions (every Slipstream position on it), movable (ready or needing a pool choice), waiting, blocked, old_aero (raw, 18 decimals). Accounts without a Slipstream position or old AERO are left out, including accounts whose positions already moved but whose automations still run on the old Slipstream managers: when read_asset_manager_current shows Slipstream managers on an account that only holds metadexcl_v1 positions, call write_account_aero_upgrade for it to get managers_to_reconnect. failed_accounts lists the accounts whose check failed, with the error: an empty accounts list means nothing to do only when failed_accounts is empty too. Otherwise tell the user those accounts could not be checked and retry later. opens_at is when the AERO token upgrade opens on Base. No calldata, prices or simulation: this is the cheap check. For the plan and the transaction call write_account_aero_upgrade. Chains: Base (8453), Optimism (10); Robinhood (4663) has no Slipstream positions and answers an empty list.

wallet_address.description: Wallet whose accounts to check. Pass this or account_address, not both.

chain_id.description: Chain ID: 8453 (Base), 10 (Optimism) or 4663 (Robinhood, nothing to upgrade)

tools.name: write_account_create
tools.description: Build an unsigned transaction to create a new Arcadia account via the Factory contract. account_version: 3 with creditor → V3 margin account (can borrow/leverage). account_version: 0 or 4 → V4 spot account (no borrowing, creditor is ignored, any ERC20 allowed). Returns the predicted account address (deterministic via CREATE2).

salt.description: Unique salt (uint32) for deterministic account address

wallet_address.description: Wallet address that will send the transaction (tx.origin, needed for address prediction)

account_version.description: Account version: 0 = latest (V4 spot), 3 = margin (can borrow). 1/2 = legacy.

creditor.description: Lending pool address for V3 margin account. Ignored for V4 spot accounts (version 0 or 4).

tools.name: write_account_deposit
tools.description: Build an unsigned transaction to deposit assets into an Arcadia account as collateral. Supports ERC20 tokens and ERC721 NFTs (LP positions). NOT needed before write_account_add_liquidity: that tool deposits from wallet atomically. Ensure the account is approved first (call read_wallet_allowances to check, then write_wallet_approve if needed). Account version is auto-detected on-chain (override with account_version if needed).

asset_amounts.description: Amounts in raw units/wei, one per asset

asset_ids.description: Token IDs: 0 for ERC20, NFT token ID for ERC721

asset_types.description: V4 only. Asset types per asset: 1=ERC20, 2=ERC721, 3=ERC1155. If omitted, inferred from asset_ids (non-zero → ERC721).

account_version.description: Override account version (3 or 4). Auto-detected on-chain if omitted.

tools.name: write_account_withdraw
tools.description: Build an unsigned transaction to withdraw assets from an Arcadia account to the owner's wallet. Only the account owner can withdraw. Will revert if the account has debt and withdrawal would make it undercollateralized. Does not support max_uint256: pass exact amounts from read_account_info. Account version is auto-detected on-chain (override with account_version if needed).

asset_amounts.description: Amounts in raw units/wei, one per asset

asset_ids.description: Token IDs: 0 for ERC20, NFT token ID for ERC721

asset_types.description: V4 only. Asset types per asset: 1=ERC20, 2=ERC721, 3=ERC1155. If omitted, inferred from asset_ids (non-zero → ERC721).

account_version.description: Override account version (3 or 4). Auto-detected on-chain if omitted.

tools.name: write_account_borrow
tools.description: Build an unsigned transaction to borrow from an Arcadia lending pool against account collateral. NOT needed for leveraged LP: write_account_add_liquidity handles borrowing internally when leverage > 0. Only works with margin accounts (created with a creditor/lending pool). Spot accounts (no creditor) cannot borrow: the tool will validate this and reject. Before borrowing, verify the account has positive free margin via read_account_info: collateral_value must exceed used_margin.

account_address.description: Arcadia account address used as collateral

tools.name: write_account_repay
tools.description: Repay debt to an Arcadia lending pool using tokens from the wallet (requires ERC20 allowance). To repay using account collateral instead (no wallet tokens needed), use write_account_deleverage. Check allowance first (read_wallet_allowances), then approve the pool if needed (write_wallet_approve). Check outstanding debt with read_account_info.

amount.description: Amount in raw units, or 'max_uint256' to repay all debt in full

tools.name: write_account_add_liquidity
tools.description: Multi-step flash-action: atomically combines [deposit from wallet] + [use account collateral] + [swap to optimal ratio] + [mint LP] + [borrow if leveraged] in ONE transaction. Do NOT call write_account_deposit separately. Capital sources: wallet tokens (deposits array), existing account collateral (use_account_assets=true), or both. Check allowances first (read_wallet_allowances), then approve if needed (write_wallet_approve). Supports depositing multiple tokens and minting multiple LP positions in one tx. Works with both margin accounts (can leverage) and spot accounts (no leverage). For workflows, call read_guides('strategies'). The returned calldata is time-sensitive: sign and broadcast within 30 seconds. If the transaction reverts due to price movement, rebuild and sign again immediately (retry at least once before giving up), passing only the accept_price_checks the user already confirmed. Response includes tenderly_sim_url and tenderly_sim_status for pre-broadcast validation. expected_value_change is in raw units of the account's numeraire token (6 decimals for USDC, 18 for WETH). Negative = cost to open, positive = value gained. Compare before.total_account_value and after.total_account_value for the full picture. If a pool's price is off market or one of its tokens has no price, the tool returns the price warnings, an accept_price_checks list and NO transaction. Show the warnings to the user and call again with that accept_price_checks list only after the user explicitly confirms they accept them. If a later call returns new warnings, even on a rebuild, show them and get a new confirmation before passing their list. The acknowledgement never bypasses a backend refusal.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address of the account owner

strategy_id.description: From read_strategy_list (or read_strategy_info for full range detail)

tick_lower.description: Lower tick for concentrated range. Omit for full range.

tick_upper.description: Upper tick for concentrated range. Omit for full range.

positions.description: LP positions to mint. For a single position, pass one entry.

deposits.description: Wallet tokens to deposit. Approve each token first (write_wallet_approve). Omit to use only account collateral.

asset.description: Token address to deposit from wallet

decimals.description: Token decimals (e.g. 6 for USDC, 18 for WETH). Default 18.

use_account_assets.description: If true, use ALL existing account collateral for LP minting. Fetched automatically.

leverage.description: 0 = no borrow, 2 = 2x leverage. Margin accounts only.

accept_price_checks.description: The accept_price_checks list returned with the price warnings of a previous call, passed unchanged and only after the user has explicitly confirmed those warnings. Never set it on the first call.

tools.name: write_account_remove_liquidity
tools.description:
Flash-action: PARTIALLY decreases liquidity from an LP position. The position remains open with reduced liquidity; underlying tokens stay in the account.

For FULL position exit (burn LP + swap + repay + withdraw), use write_account_close instead: it batches everything into one atomic transaction.

The returned calldata is time-sensitive — sign and broadcast within 30 seconds. If the transaction reverts due to price movement, rebuild and sign again immediately (retry at least once before giving up). Response includes tenderly_sim_url and tenderly_sim_status for pre-broadcast validation.

adjustment.description: Liquidity amount to remove (raw uint128 value as string). Must be less than total liquidity: for full removal use write_account_close.

tools.name: write_account_swap
tools.description: Flash-action: swaps assets within an Arcadia account in one atomic transaction. The backend finds the optimal swap route. NOTE: If you are closing a position (swap + repay + withdraw), prefer write_account_close which batches everything atomically. Only use this tool for standalone swaps within an active position. The returned calldata is time-sensitive: sign and broadcast within 30 seconds. If the transaction reverts due to price movement, rebuild and sign again immediately (retry at least once before giving up). Response includes tenderly_sim_url and tenderly_sim_status for pre-broadcast validation: if tenderly_sim_status is 'false', do NOT broadcast the transaction.

tools.name: write_account_deleverage
tools.description: Multi-step flash-action: sells account collateral to the debt token and repays in one atomic transaction: no wallet tokens needed. To repay from wallet tokens instead, use write_account_repay. NOTE: If you are closing a position (remove LP + swap + repay + withdraw), prefer write_account_close which batches everything atomically. Only use this tool for standalone repayment while keeping the position active. The returned calldata is time-sensitive: sign and broadcast within 30 seconds. If the transaction reverts due to price movement, rebuild and sign again immediately (retry at least once before giving up). Response includes tenderly_sim_url and tenderly_sim_status for pre-broadcast validation: if tenderly_sim_status is 'false', do NOT broadcast the transaction.

tools.name: write_account_stake
tools.description: Flash-action: stake, unstake, or claim rewards for an LP position in one atomic transaction. Use the `action` parameter to select the operation. `asset_address` is the position manager contract: pass the non-staked PM address when staking, or the staked PM address when unstaking. The returned calldata is time-sensitive, sign and broadcast within 30 seconds. If the transaction reverts due to price movement, rebuild and sign again immediately (retry at least once before giving up). Tenderly simulation may not be available for this endpoint. Verify the position exists with read_account_info before signing. Aero CL (metadexcl_v1): spot accounts stake through the Arcadia wrapper, margin accounts through the staked module, on Base, Optimism and Robinhood.

asset_id.description: NFT token ID of the LP position

tools.name: write_account_close
tools.description:
Atomic flash-action that closes an Arcadia account position in ONE transaction. Combines up to 3 steps atomically: [burn LP position] + [swap all tokens to a single target asset] + [repay debt]. Tokens remain in the account after closing: use write_account_withdraw to send them to your wallet.

ALWAYS try this tool first when closing/exiting a position. Only fall back to individual tools (write_account_remove_liquidity, write_account_swap, write_account_deleverage, write_account_withdraw) if this tool fails.

Supports two modes:
- close_lp_only=true: Burns LP and leaves underlying tokens in the account. Use as step 1 if the full close fails, then call again with close_lp_only=false to swap+repay the remaining tokens.
- close_lp_only=false (default): Full atomic close: burns LP, swaps everything to receive_assets, repays debt. Remaining tokens stay in the account. Follow up with write_account_withdraw to send to wallet. Supports multiple receive assets with custom distribution.

The returned calldata is time-sensitive — sign and broadcast within 30 seconds. If the transaction reverts due to price movement, rebuild and sign again immediately (retry at least once before giving up). Response includes tenderly_sim_url and tenderly_sim_status for pre-broadcast validation.

asset_id.description: NFT token ID (0 for ERC20 tokens)

amount.description: Amount to sell (use '1' for NFT positions)

assets.description: Assets to close/sell from the account. IMPORTANT: For LP positions (NFTs), always use amount='1' and decimals=1: do NOT pass the liquidity amount. asset_address = position manager, asset_id = NFT token ID. For ERC20 tokens: asset_id = 0, amount = full balance in raw units, decimals = real token decimals. Get all values from read_account_info.

receive_assets.description: Target assets to receive after closing. For a single target, pass one entry. Required when close_lp_only=false. Omit for close_lp_only=true.

decimals.description: Token decimals of the target asset

distribution.description: Fraction of proceeds (0-1). Defaults to equal split across all receive assets.

close_lp_only.description: true = only burn LP positions, leave underlying tokens in account. false = full close (burn + swap + repay).

tools.name: write_account_aero_upgrade
tools.description: Upgrade one Arcadia account to Aero (MetadexCL V1) in one flashAction: every Slipstream V1/V2/V3 position (dex_protocol slipstream*, staked or not, see read_account_info) moves to the Aero CL pool with the same pair and variant at the same range and tick spacing (when Aero has no pool at that tick spacing, the user picks another one), and every unit of old AERO (loose, in rewards, in an old-AERO pair) becomes the new AERO. Returns the plan and, when anything can go now, the unsigned transaction. Only the account owner can sign it. The backend decides what moves: report items[].status and items[].reason as given, never decide eligibility yourself. status ready: sign transaction. choices_required: some position has status choose with options[] (every Aero pool on its pair, with apy, tvl_usd, is_new, tick_spacing, range_widened, default and disabled_reason); ask the user to pick one whose disabled_reason is null, then call again with it in choices so one transaction moves everything. The transaction returned with choices_required moves only the ready items: sign it alone only when the user wants to leave the choose positions where they are. waiting: each item's reason says why (pool_not_on_aero, staking_not_open, target_price_mismatch, account_unhealthy, ...); a waiting item with an option whose disabled_reason is null can still move with that pick, so ask the user; do not retry in a loop. not_open: the AERO upgrade contract does not accept deposits at the moment. A 422 saying a pool is not selectable: drop that pick, call again without it and ask the user again. Pass accounts (up to 10) instead of account_address for one plan per account; the accounts share one AERO upgrade budget. multisends groups the accounts that got a transaction, in order: a Safe signs one MultiSend per group (each below max_gas_per_tx). After it confirms, reconnect managers_to_reconnect with write_account_automations and verify with read_account_info (next_steps). Spot and margin accounts can hold Aero positions, staked or not. Chains: 8453 (Base, default), 10 (Optimism) and 4663 (Robinhood, which has nothing to upgrade). Calldata is time-sensitive: sign promptly, rebuild on a price revert. After a transaction confirms, pass its block as min_block on the next call so the plan is not built on older state. When the transaction's simulation reverts the tool returns the plan with an error and no transaction; tenderly_sim_status unavailable means Tenderly did not answer: call once more before signing. A plan without a transaction can still show tenderly_sim_status failure: the account's health or a lending pool limit refused the move, and the items wait on account_unhealthy or exposure_limit; report those reasons and do not rebuild.

account_address.description: Arcadia account to upgrade. Pass this or accounts, not both.

accounts.description: Up to 10 Arcadia accounts of one owner: one plan and transaction each

choices.description: Pool picks for positions with status choose (or waiting with a selectable option), from a previous call's options (disabled_reason null)

slippage.description: Price band the mint accepts, in bps. Omit for the backend default: 150, or 500 when the owner is a contract (a Safe).

min_block.description: Block of the transaction you just confirmed, so the plan reads state at or after it

chain_id.description: Chain ID: 8453 (Base), 10 (Optimism) or 4663 (Robinhood, nothing to upgrade)

tools.name: write_wallet_approve
tools.description: Build an unsigned approval transaction. For ERC20 tokens: generates approve(spender, amount). For ERC721/ERC1155 NFTs (e.g. LP positions): generates setApprovalForAll(operator, true). Required before write_account_deposit or write_account_add_liquidity (when depositing from wallet). Tip: call read_wallet_allowances first to check if approval already exists: skip this if the current allowance is sufficient.

spender_address.description: Address being approved — use the Arcadia account address for deposits

asset_type.description: Token type: 'erc20' (default) for fungible tokens, 'erc721' or 'erc1155' for NFTs (LP positions)

amount.description: ERC20 only: amount in raw units, or 'max_uint256' for unlimited. Ignored for NFTs.

tools.name: write_wallet_upgrade_velo
tools.description: Upgrade VELO held in a wallet on Optimism to the new AERO on Base: ordered unsigned wallet transactions from owner_address, an approve when the allowance is short, then depositLiquid on the Velodrome migration with the Hyperlane fee as value. 0.044 new AERO per VELO arrives at the same address on Base once the message lands. VELO inside an Arcadia account must be withdrawn to the wallet first (write_account_withdraw). VELO stays usable, so this is optional. Optimism (chain_id 10) only. 'upgrade unavailable' names the contract's reason: not_open (with the opening time), paused, budget_exhausted, recipient_not_deployed (a contract wallet with no code on Base).

owner_address.description: Wallet holding the VELO on Optimism; receives the AERO on Base

amount.description: Raw units (18 decimals). Omit for the wallet's full VELO balance.

tools.name: write_pool_deposit
tools.description: Build an unsigned deposit transaction into an Arcadia lending tranche (ERC-4626). Lenders deposit the pool's underlying asset (USDC/WETH/cbBTC) and receive tranche shares that accrue interest from borrowers. Requires prior ERC-20 approval to the tranche (see write_wallet_approve). To check current lender yield, call read_pool_list or read_pool_info.

tranche_address.description: Tranche contract address (ERC-4626 vault). Get this from read_pool_list: each pool's `tranches[0].address`.

assets.description: Amount of underlying asset to deposit, in raw units (e.g. '1000000' = 1 USDC since USDC has 6 decimals).

receiver.description: Address that receives the minted tranche shares. Usually the depositor's own wallet.

tools.name: write_pool_redeem
tools.description: Build an unsigned redeem transaction to withdraw from an Arcadia lending tranche (ERC-4626). Burns tranche shares and returns the corresponding amount of underlying asset, including accrued interest. The owner must be the shares holder; receiver is where the underlying asset is sent.

tranche_address.description: Tranche contract address (ERC-4626 vault). Get this from read_pool_list: each pool's `tranches[0].address`.

shares.description: Amount of tranche shares to burn, in raw units. To redeem everything, use the owner's full share balance.

receiver.description: Address that receives the underlying asset. Usually the owner's own wallet.

owner.description: Address that owns the tranche shares being burned. Normally the signer's own wallet.

tools.name: write_account_automations
tools.description:
Configure an account's automations from a list of intents and return the unsigned setAssetManagers transaction. The backend resolves which asset managers each intent needs, validates that the combination is compatible, encodes the metadata and builds the calldata, so you describe the desired outcome rather than the contracts.

With mode 'save' (the default) the intents array is the complete desired state: the backend diffs it against what is currently enabled, so any automation you leave out is DISABLED by the returned transaction. Pass a single intent with enabled: false to turn everything off.

Mode 'preview' validates and resolves the intents WITHOUT reading chain state and returns no transaction, because its calldata carries no disable entries and would only partially apply the state. Use it to check a combination is legal or to show a plan; use 'save' to get something signable. To toggle one automation without restating the rest, use write_account_automations_delta.

Intents:
- compound_fees: reinvest earned fees/rewards back into the LP. Optional 'tokens' scopes it per yielding token. A staked reward that is not a pool token is swapped in via CowSwap automatically.
- claim_rewards: claim yield out. config.mode as_earned pays the tokens as-is, convert_to swaps them to config.buy_token via CowSwap. config.convert_tokens converts only a subset and claims the rest as-earned. config.destination account or wallet.
- add_to_lp: fold idle pool-token balances (deposits, rebalance leftovers) back into the LP. Opt-in per token.
- claim_merkl: auto-claim Merkl incentive rewards. Independent of the compounder/claimer/cowswapper triad and needs no position context.
- rebalance: reposition the LP. strategy out_of_range (default), take_profit (runs on the dedicated profit-taker contract), or protocol_owned_liquidity.

Pass position_id (from assets[] in read_account_info) and the backend fills in protocol, is_staked, token0, token1 and reward_tokens for you; anything you pass explicitly wins. claim_merkl needs no position context.

Rules the backend enforces (a violation is returned as an error, never written on-chain):
- Every yielding token must be assigned to exactly one of compound_fees or claim_rewards. Scoping one to a subset without covering the rest is rejected, and no token may be in both.
- A wallet or custom-recipient payout requires a pure as-earned claim: nothing converted, and every yielding token claimed. Converts settle in the account.
- convert_tokens must be a subset of the claimed tokens, and buy_token cannot be a compounded token, a converted token, or an add_to_lp folded token.
- Each intent kind may appear only once, and a token list must not be empty or name a token the position does not yield.

Returns { valid, errors, warnings, human_summary, plan, diff, transaction }. When a compatibility rule fires the call returns an error and no transaction: read errors[].reason, adjust the intents and retry. There is deliberately no transaction when the account already matches the request (no_changes_needed), when the Tenderly simulation predicts a revert (an error), or in preview mode (preview_only). Call read_asset_manager_intents first to see which intents this account can enable.

trigger_lower_tick_ratio.description: Offset from tick_lower as a fraction of the position's tick range, 1e6-scaled. max_tolerance.description: Max price deviation (MEV/slippage cap), 1e18-scaled: 1e18 = 100%, so 5000000000000000 = 0.5% (the default) and 50000000000000000 = 5%. Omit for the pool's default. AAA pools are floored at 5%.

tools.name: write_account_automations_delta
tools.description:

Unlike write_account_automations this is a delta, not a full desired state: automations you do not mention are left untouched. Use it to switch one automation on or off without restating the others.

The enable array takes intents to switch on (same shapes as write_account_automations). To turn an automation OFF, call read_asset_manager_current, take the address of the manager serving it, and pass that address in the disable array: an intent with enabled: false in `enable` is rejected because the backend would ignore it.
